purpose: Small verified procedural experience, not authoritative task state or historical data

lessons.lesson: Reject Boolean chronology boundaries before Number coercion; Number(true) becomes 1 and bypasses simple integer guards. Retain BCE and valid integer boundaries.
Check that a caller-supplied root is nonblank before path.resolve; resolving an empty root first silently turns it into cwd.

A model-authored test can alter files in its unprivileged runner, including an output artifact. Rebind and independently verify the handoff against the original trusted GitHub event before privileged publication.
Review existing relevant scoped CI-passing PRs before requesting a new model patch. An unrelated or parked PR is not a global lock, and CI never authorizes automatic merge.

An ISO YYYY-MM-DD format regex does not reject impossible calendar dates. Validate actual Gregorian month lengths and leap-year rules before any database query; preserve valid early CE dates and independent BCE publication years.
